tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
ASUS PRIME Z790-P WIFI-CSM 12th/13th/14th GEN ATX MOTHERBOARD

ASUS PRIME Z790-P WIFI-CSM is an ATX motherboard built on the Intel Z790 chipset, supporting Intel’s 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen Core processors (LGA 1700 socket). It's part of ASUS’s Corporate Stable Model (CSM) lineup, aimed at providing stable, long-term availability and enterprise-level support.

  • CPU Support: Intel 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors
  • Memory: Up to 128GB DDR5 across 4 DIMM slots; supports speeds up to 7200+ MHz (OC)
  • Graphics Outputs: HDMI and DisplayPort (up to 4K@60Hz)
  • Expansion Slots: 1 x PCIe 5.0 x16, 3 x PCIe 4.0 x16 (x4 mode), 1 x PCIe 3.0 x1
  • Storage: 3 x M.2 slots, 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports
  • Networking: Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet, Intel Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2
  • USB Ports:

          1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C

          1 x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A

          2 x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A

          4 x USB 2.0 Type-A

  • Audio: Realtek 7.1 HD Audio Codec with premium capacitors
  • Cooling: Fan Xpert 4 support, multiple fan headers, and AIO pump header
  • Form Factor: ATX (30.5 cm x 23.4 cm)
  • Protection and Reliability: ASUS 5X Protection III: includes DIGI+ VRM, LANGuard, Overvoltage Protection, SafeSlot Core+, and stainless-steel I/O

This board is well-suited for professional or high-performance home setups that need DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0, and solid networking and storage capabilities.
